notes: Derived from 150 items (75 Play Store, 75 YouTube); re-validate against Reddit before scaling.
Code only what is observable in the text; when in doubt use unknown.
stop_trigger = the event; root_cause = the mechanism that makes the event lead to doubt/stop. A trigger can exist with root_cause unknown.
Play Store items only about stocks/IPO/F&O: code platform fields, leave SIP-journey fields unknown.

fields.name: root_cause
fields.question: What underlying MECHANISM (beyond the trigger) explains the doubt/stop? Code only when the text shows the mechanism, not just the event. Most important field.

values.definition: Reads own performance through a WRONG or partial frame: point-to-point NAV, absolute rupees, the fund's headline return vs their own SIP return, a single day's P&L, or hindsight lumpsum comparison. The error is in HOW they read the number.
values.include_example: agar lumsum kiya hota toh aaj benefits hota na jabki market tab se girta ja raha hai
values.exclude_rule: Reads correctly but is unhappy because reality fell short of a stated expectation -> expectation_violation (both may apply).

values.definition: Reads performance CORRECTLY, but a prior expectation they state (return rate, time to profit, no losses) was not met.
values.include_example: I thought in 3-5 yrs i will definitely get minimum 10-12 percent
values.exclude_rule: Expectation not stated -> not this. If the reading itself is flawed, add return_misreading too.

values.definition: Judges SIP against FD/RD/savings and finds it lacking.
values.include_example: isse jyada to bank ki FD se mil jata h
values.exclude_rule: Comparison to lumpsum or another fund -> return_misreading or timing_mindset.

values.definition: A SPECIFIC person steers the hold/stop decision for an EXISTING SIP: the writer started on a family member's, friend's, advisor's or creator's say-so and defers to them, blames them, or explicitly hands the decision to a named person/creator they follow.
values.include_example: mene apke bolne pr 2lamsum or sip kiya hu switch krdu batana
values.exclude_rule: Asking a forum or the public 'should I continue or stop?' -> not this; code the mechanism (volatility_mismatch, expectation_violation, ...). Asking which fund to pick -> not this.

values.definition: A fixed SIP clashes with income shocks, irregular/low income or competing needs, so stopping, skipping, avoiding or planning gaps in the SIP is seen as the only option.
values.include_example: just need one month to get back on track
values.exclude_rule: Debit failed despite money in bank -> payment_plumbing.

values.definition: Continuity broken by mandate/autopay/debit mechanics or penalties, independent of the user's intent or funds.
values.include_example: auto payment fails in mutual fund sip and there is no retry done by the app
values.exclude_rule: User lacked money -> cashflow_rigidity.

values.definition: Feels misled or cheated by the app (charges, regular plans, Prime, forced accounts, wrong data, unaccountable support).
values.include_example: You guys started selling Regular MFs in the name of prime
values.exclude_rule: Distrust of MFs/markets in general -> product_distrust.

values.definition: Believes MFs/markets are rigged, a scam or dishonest in general.
values.include_example: MF is completely scams all controlled by big players

values.definition: Holds high-volatility funds (small/mid/thematic) and is distressed by their swings.
values.include_example: Motilal mid cap os falling like anything should I continue my sip?

values.definition: Treats investing as market timing; prefers lumpsum/dip-buying so SIP feels inferior or optional.
values.include_example: I dont do SIP, I do a manual lumpsum everymonth
values.exclude_rule: Buying extra on dips while continuing SIP calmly -> do not code as a root cause.

values.definition: Cancels or changes a SIP to fix the portfolio itself: fund overlap, too many funds, regular->direct, cleaning up hastily chosen first funds.
values.include_example: too many funds with overlapping holdings so stopping two SIPs

changes_from_draft: Sharpened return_misreading (wrong frame) vs expectation_violation (right frame, unmet prior); both may co-occur.
Added metric_branch to map every item onto the metric tree (analysis/metric_tree_v1.md).
Added platform (groww / other / unknown) because the business metric is measured on Groww.
Added rationale (required when any field uses 'other').
v1.1 action: added restructured (16/60 Reddit): stopping one fund's SIP while still investing.
v1.1 unmet_need: added portfolio_construction_help (~46/60, previously forced into independent_reassurance).

v1.1 boundaries: planned addition to a running SIP = increased; step-ups = intent branch; stage computed from stated start vs post date; borrowed_conviction only when the hold/stop decision is handed to others; cashflow_rigidity includes avoiding or planning gaps in a SIP because of cash flow.
v1.2 stop_trigger: added tax_rule_change (new tax regime / 80C / tax rules make the SIP pointless).
v1.3 action: added attempted_blocked (~8 items: tried to cancel/skip/pause/redeem, app did not allow it).
v1.3 stop_trigger: added missing_notification (not told about a failed/missed instalment or SIP change).
v1.4 added investor_experience (first_time / experienced / unknown): the brief is about first-time investors and r/FIREIndia / TradingQ&A lean experienced. Replaces the loose first_time flag.

v1.4 action: added nearly_stopped (seriously considered stopping, then decided to continue) and widened continued to 'kept the SIP running through a loss, doubt or pressure to stop' so stayed stories can be compared with drop-offs.
v1.5 stop_trigger: added app_malfunction (app crash, login failure, blank screen, a feature not working) when it is not a payment, modify or redemption problem.
v1.6 stop_trigger: added debit_after_cancel (5+ items: money still debited after cancelling) and support_failure (5+ items: support unreachable or unhelpful was the push).
v1.6 added stay_reason (multi): what kept a stayer going. Stayed stories are the control group, and root_cause only explains doubt/stopping, so their reasons had nowhere to go.

v1.7 root_cause: borrowed_conviction narrowed to a SPECIFIC person steering the hold/stop decision (started on their advice, or hands the decision to a named person/creator they follow). Asking a forum whether to continue is not enough: code the mechanism instead. 52 tags re-checked by hand (data/recode/out/recode_04.jsonl): 8 kept, 44 re-coded.
